parsed.explanation: The combined regime imposes universal-exposure measures on every trans visitor: national document rules force birth-sex markers, visa officers are instructed to refuse cases on sex doubt and to weigh lifetime fraud findings, and foreign governments issue trans-specific travel advisories after documented detentions of visitors. Within the division, facility use per identity is banned with a documented arrest-and-custody precedent (24 hours in a men's ward), a felony bars care for an accompanying minor, IDs cannot be made congruent, and no statewide nondiscrimination or hate-crime recourse exists. Severity stays short of organised imprisonment campaigns, but tier-1 exposures with thin remedies and state threat-framing dominate.

entry_documents.exposure: National rules force birth-sex markers on passports/visas; officers instructed to refuse on sex doubt and weigh lifetime fraud ineligibility; visitors report confiscated passports, stranded travellers; foreign advisories issued after detentions of visitors.
entry_documents.protection: Litigation ongoing; X passports valid until expiry; fraud finding requires four elements, waivers exist.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy can escalate to fraud investigation, refusal, or detention at entry.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Documented national custody harms: corrections policies stripping hormones, immigration-custody forced labour, beatings, sexual abuse; documented 24-hour holding of an arrested trans woman in a men's ward.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: National hate-crime statute; courts have enjoined some orders.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: A facilities trespass arrest routes a visitor into birth-sex custody with documented harm.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Statewide 2022/2024 facility bans (schools, campuses, government buildings); a documented arrest of a trans woman using a women's restroom, charged with trespass (up to 60 days); four states criminalise in some circumstances.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Trespass trigger requires refusal to depart, not automatic arrest; about half the national map has no such ban.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Visitors in any public building face the ban; enforcement precedents exist.

care_services.exposure: Class C felony (10 years) for providers giving trans care to under-19s, enforceable since 2023; an accompanying minor cannot access care, and a provider exposure attaches. No insurance protections.
care_services.protection: Adult HRT access not criminalised; two municipal ordinances offer limited discrimination protection.
care_services.interaction: Care-seeking minor triggers felony exposure for the provider; adult care access undocumented.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: State law declares gender an immutable binary; national rhetoric ('radical gender ideology', counterterrorism prioritisation of 'radically pro-transgender' groups); 2026 law invalidating non-birth-sex documents described as a template.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Several orders enjoined; civil-liberties litigation ongoing.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State binary declaration underwrites facility and document enforcement.

minors_guardians.exposure: Minor accompanying a visitor cannot obtain gender-affirming care (felony for providers); schools' bathroom and sports rules apply to enrolled minors; national orders targeting facilitators of minors' transition.
minors_guardians.interaction: Guardian's travel plans constrained by care ban and school facility rules.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Trans-woman killing rate recorded at 3.8/100k/yr (undercount floor, 2008–2025) — magnitude unknowable; no state hate-crime coverage of gender identity; statewide polling among lowest-support for trans inclusion.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute applies; employment circuit protects gender identity.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police ID checks expose incongruent licences (surgery requirement upheld 2024).

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No statewide nondiscrimination protection; hate-crime law excludes gender identity; visitor-side recourse essentially absent; appellate circuit hostile to document relief.
remedies_unknowns.protection: National marriage recognition and national hate-crime statute are partial backstops.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Complaint channels exist nationally but outcomes in this division are unpromising.

anchor_checks.comparison: Vellandra's register bars entry outright but stops at exclusion. This regime similarly applies universal document screening with refusal and fraud findings, but adds in-jurisdiction criminal facility exposure and custody harm, sitting at or slightly below that anchor; 0.30 fits.

Kestrel Isles yields administrative denial and delay with functioning appeal desks. Here appeals on document congruence were denied through 2024, facility use is criminalised in the division, and no statewide recourse exists — materially worse than this anchor.

Meridia offers trained border officers, tribunal release and compensation. This regime lacks comparable remedies, carries documented birth-sex custody and national custody abuse, so it rates far below; the gap justifies the low band rather than mid-scale.

Caldera's selective morality enforcement with entrapment is episodic; here exposure is universal (every document check, every public facility) with state-backed threat framing, but outcomes rarely reach imprisonment — comparable tier, slight edge above 0.25 anchors.

parsed.synthesis: The operative regime combines national universal-exposure screening (birth-sex markers, fraud findings, case-note tagging, documented visitor detentions) with division-level facility bans that produced a real arrest and birth-sex holding, a felony care ban reaching travelling minors, uncorrectable ID incongruence, and no statewide remedy. Severity rarely reaches prolonged imprisonment for adults, keeping the score above the 0.25 tier, but tier-1 exposures with documented custodial harm and no working recourse place it clearly in the High Risk band, near 0.30.
